# Unit count lies. Profit per site doesn't.

> Free calculator for independent fire-extinguisher and life-safety inspection route operators: find real monthly profit per customer site after recharge, hydro-test, and replacement materials, tags, drive time, and recordkeeping cost, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
